name: CYRE Guardian
description: On-chain risk intelligence for Solana via MCP. Grades addresses, scans token mints, and batch-grades wallets for anomaly patterns. Patterns, not verdicts. Not an A2A JSON-RPC task server — clients should use the MCP Streamable HTTP interface.

extensions.description: HTTP-layer x402 payment is required on POST /mcp before Streamable HTTP MCP traffic.

skills.name: grade_address
skills.description: Risk grade a Solana address from on-chain history (patterns with points and reasons). Patterns, not verdicts.

skills.name: scan_token
skills.description: Scan a Solana token mint for mint/freeze authority status, supply, and holder concentration. Patterns, not verdicts.

skills.name: batch_grade
skills.description: Grade up to 25 Solana addresses in one call. Patterns, not verdicts.
